description: This source file contains SwiftUI extensions for the CronSettings class, providing UI components to display and interact with CronJob objects, including job rows, context menus, headers, detail cards, run history, and payload summaries.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view representing a row for a given CronJob, displaying its status and enabling interactions.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Provides a context menu with actions for a CronJob, such as run, open transcript, enable/disable, edit, and delete.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Displays detailed header information for a CronJob, including name, id, status toggles, and control buttons.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Shows detailed information about a CronJob, including schedule, description, agent, session, wake mode, next and last run times, status, errors, and payload.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Displays recent run history of a CronJob, with refresh capability.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Represents a single run log entry in the run history list.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary view of a CronJob's payload content.
